desc:
🦐 KRILLION: THE DAILY DIVE 🦐

7 prompts. 25 seconds each. The rarer your answer, the deeper you sink.

Name a fruit that starts with B. A superhero team. A city in Asia. Obvious answers keep you near the surface, but think of one nobody else will and you dive all the way down to One in a Krillion.

🌊 A NEW DIVE EVERY DAY: everyone gets the same 7 prompts. Build your streak and see how deep you went compared to everyone else.
👥 CREW DIVES: dive the same prompts live with up to 7 friends.
♾️ UNLIMITED: replay past prompts as often as you like.
🎬 THEMED PACKS: Movies, Sports, Geography and Words.
🥚 SKINS & EGGS: earn coins from your daily dive, buy new dive buddies, or hatch a Roe Egg for one of 16 egg-only skins. Your crew sees the skin you wear!

How deep can you go?
